text:
maria: idea: introduce a "lite" sidecar handshake for Private deployments to reduce manifest complexity and speed bootstrap. only exchange auth, version, and health probe.
aj: sounds promising. how do we handle secrets/KMS keys for model artifacts?
maria: lite won't fetch secrets. sidecar will return a key-handle and control plane performs decryption or delegates to a KMS adapter. avoids embedding HSM access in the sidecar.
tom: we also need eviction signals. propose heartbeat + an /eviction_reason endpoint. when eviction happens emit metric and start graceful fallback window.
lina: important: fallback to Hosted must be opt-in. many customers can't allow cross-hosted data movement for compliance. we need explicit org policy.
aj: propose fallback_policy enum: deny | cached_only | redirect_hosted. default = deny. admin can opt-in redirect_hosted for non-sensitive workloads.
kyle: rollout plan: feature-flag per-org, canary to 5 orgs, then broader. metrics to track: sidecar.handshake.latency, eviction.count, fallback.attempts, fallback.latency.
maria: handshake sketch: {"mode":"lite","version":"1","auth":"token-hash","probe_interval_ms":5000} (proto simplified)
tom: add serving_hint header from client: low_latency | cost_saver | compliant. helps routing and fallback decisions without negotiating heavy capability lists.
lina: serving_hint leaks intent. require ACL mapping and customer consent for any cross-host fallback. audit logs mandatory.
infra-bot: eviction-detector v0.3 deployed to staging  test hooks enabled :rocket:
aj: telemetry: flow a correlation_id sidecar->runtime->controlplane. sample traces 10%, capture full on eviction. include trace_id in eviction metric.
kyle: add chaos test simulating eviction during inflight requests and rollback tests for handshake regressions.
maria: next steps: draft RFC with handshake proto, policy enum, migration guide, and rollout checklist. volunteers: maria, aj, tom. 30m sync next Tue.
lina: I'll review security/residency sections.
kyle: :thumbsup: will own canary automation.
maria: PR created: https://git.internal/r/PR-438  please comment. closing thread.
